The m135, m141, m72, m216, m207, m86, m89, m11, m94, and m165 points sample distinct delayed regimes across donors, basic heteroaromatics, carbonyls, and fused systems. m106, m116, m205, m206, and m119 extend ether and donor curves around measured failures. The m177 and m202 groups are matched solvent or amount-response experiments designed to discriminate local interactions from smooth loading laws. m159, m193, m28, and m194 fill intermediate transition gaps where onset and completion have already behaved differently. Together the batch spans PE and DCM, low and high solvent strength, 50/100/150-ul loading, and multiple chemical families while retaining several scientifically meaningful within-molecule curves. These labels should improve generalization by calibrating conditional transitions and tail behavior across the Row-distribution."}
